summary.text: SØNDRE KULLERØD 1 AS is a private limited company registered in Sandefjord, founded 2003-05-08. It was previously named TEKÅGEL INVEST XVII AS until 2003-10-09. Its registered activity: "Handel, industri og eiendomsinvesteringer og virksomheter i forbindelse med dette, herunder deltakelse i andre selskaper med lignende virksomhet, samt investering i fast eiendom, verdipapirer og andre formuesobjekter." Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 385 860 NOK and the annual result was 3 324 971 NOK; operating income was up from 5 977 784 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 2 169 962 NOK in 2024 to 3 324 971 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 16 246 917 NOK in 2024 to 16 271 888 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Dag Klettum (daglig leder and styrets leder). Recent changes in the register: postal address set to Thor Bryns gate 11 on 2026-02-03.
